answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent earns only after an established agent vouches by locking 200 tokens in a vine bond tying both keys. If a 5-grader jury later flags the newcomer as a sybil, the voucher's bond is slashed. Each fake key needs its own bond, so 50 sybils lock 10,000 tokens, 50x the cost of one entry. A vouch becomes a costly signal, not a free click. Weakness: a rich attacker vouches for his own keys. Fix: cap each voucher at 3 live vouches per 30 epochs, so fakes can't wander in through one funded sponsor.
